ai.thread_title: Andrej Karpathy: focus shifts to **interpreting LLM outputs**, not testing capabilities
ai.name: Andrej Karpathy
ai.role: AI researcher, Tesla, high-engagement X builder
ai.hook: New testing paradigm: ask LLM to explain using controlled languages, ramble sessions, large token budgets.
insights: **ASD-STE100 (controlled language spec)** helps LLMs self-explain clearly; improves interpretability over raw capability tests
**Voice rambling + long context** replaces structured prompting; LLM explores reasoning space you're too lazy to type

ai.for_you: For agency workflows: use controlled languages and long-context rambles to extract client reasoning from agents. Testing 'can it create an SVG?' is dead; testing 'can it explain *why* it chose this approach?' is the new bar. Apply to agent audits and quality gates.
ai.what_changed: Karpathy's highest-engagement tweet signals insider consensus: capability plateau, interpretation and reasoning quality matter more.
ai.why_it_made_the_cut: Most-engaged builder tweet of the week; points to practitioner-level testing philosophy shift.

ai.why_it_made_the_cut: Highest-signal posts on economic shift from two credible operators.
